source.title: Lumont - Benign Horn
source.name: Lumont
source.description: A courageous Tank who is skilled at absorbing damage and melee combat.

skills.name: Lumont's Charge

description.raw: Lumont selects a tile in range and charges at it, knocking enemies in his path back toward the selected tile. When Lumont reaches the selected tile, he deals 240% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to all adjacent enemies and taunts them for 3s. Lumont is unaffected while casting this skill.
active: Lumont selects a tile in range and charges at it, knocking enemies in his path back toward the selected tile.
When Lumont reaches the selected tile, he deals 240% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to all adjacent enemies and taunts them for 3s.
Lumont is unaffected while casting this skill.

skills.description_lite: Lumont charges toward enemies in a line, dealing damage and knocking them back toward the selected tile.

skills.name: Totem Ward

description.raw: Lumont gains a shield from Totem ward that blocks 450% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based) damage for 12s. For every adjacent enemy, the shield value is increased by 30%. He also increases Phys DEF of 2 closest allies by 30% for 7s.
active: Lumont gains a shield from Totem ward that blocks 450% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based) damage for 12s.
For every adjacent enemy, the shield value is increased by 30%.
He also increases Phys DEF of 2 closest allies by 30% for 7s.

text: Increases the shield value by 35% for every adjacent enemy.
Increases the shield value by 40% for every adjacent enemy.
Increases the shield value by 45% for every adjacent enemy.

skills.description_lite: Lumont gains a shield. THe more enemies nearby, the higher the shield value.

skills.name: War Stomp

description.raw: Lumont stomps the ground dealing 240% (ATK-based) damage to adjacent enemies and stunning them for 1 + 0.25 (SP-based)s.
active: Lumont stomps the ground dealing 240% (ATK-based) damage to adjacent enemies and stunning them for 1 + 0.25 (SP-based)s.

text: Reduces this skill's cooldown by 1s for every enemy hit.

skills.description_lite: Lumont stomps the ground to deal AoE damage.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Lumont increases his Haste by 9 during battle. His Haste is increased by an extra 6 when there are at least 2 enemies nearby.
active: Lumont increases his Haste by 9 during battle.
His Haste is increased by an extra 6 when there are at least 2 enemies nearby.

text: Lumont increases his Haste by 12 during battle.
His Haste is increased by an extra 8 when there are at least 2 enemies nearby.
Lumont increases his Haste by 15 during battle.
His Haste is increased by an extra 10 when there are at least 2 enemies nearby.

skills.description_lite: Lumont increases his Haste during battle, and it further increases when there are multiple enemies.

skills.name: Totem Slam

description.raw: Lumont slams the ground with totem 3 times after receiving damage equal to 40% of his max HP, dealing 150% (ATK-based) damage to enemies within 1, 2, and 3 tiles in order and reducing their ATK by 25% for 6s. His 3rd slam also knocks the enemies hit into the air. Lumont is unaffected while casting this skill.
active: Lumont slams the ground with totem 3 times after receiving damage equal to 40% of his max HP, dealing 150% (ATK-based) damage to enemies within 1, 2, and 3 tiles in order and reducing their ATK by 25% for 6s.
His 3rd slam also knocks the enemies hit into the air.
Lumont is unaffected while casting this skill.

text: Gains an extra skill attempt when a battle starts or an ally is defeated for the first time.

skills.description_lite: Lumont slams the ground after receiving a certain amount of damage, dealing damage to enemies within various ranges and reducing their ATK.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Lumont recovers 7% (HP-based) HP per second while shielded by Totem Ward.
active: Lumont recovers 7% (HP-based) HP per second while shielded by Totem Ward.

skills.description_lite: Lumont recovers HP per second while shielded by Totem Ward.
